evidence.name: Screen field: Extra line look
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Extra line look" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Extra line look
sections.description: Open this to override the third line's font size, weight, color, alignment, and the padding around it; it appears only with the Image + Title + 2 Subtitles template. Style it as the smallest, quietest text so it never competes with the headline or supporting line. Leave it on theme defaults unless you truly need a change, since overrides apply to this line on every slide of the carousel.
